The dial face is white with black numerical markings (appearing to be in millibars/hPa) and a single black pointer hand. There are faint decorative weather indicators on the lower half of the dial. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige gradient.

The reflection on the brass casing is overly smooth and lacks the micro-scratches or imperfections expected in real polished metal. It has a 'plastic-like' sheen despite the color suggesting metal.
The center pivot of the needle is slightly indistinct. The needle seems to emerge from the background rather than being mounted on a distinct physical pin or cap.
